name: Doomtide

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of churning magical Darkness fills a point within range; a strong wind (Gust of Wind) disperses it. A creature in it when it appears, when it moves onto it, entering it, or ending its turn there makes a Wisdom save once per turn: on a failure 5d6 Psychic damage and −1d6 on its saving throws until the end of its next turn; on a success half damage only. At the start of each of your turns the Sphere drifts 10 feet away from you. The Circle casting isn't in the game.
